explication: NGINX is a configurable web server, reverse proxy, load balancer, API gateway, and content cache. Its principal workflow is a worker accepting network traffic, dispatching it through a protocol handler and configured features, then serving content or proxying to an upstream. The graph also shows stream and mail services, TLS and newer HTTP/QUIC protocol support, and the master/worker runtime. README statements support the product capabilities and process model; several internal dispatch links are dashed because the sampled excerpts do not show their wiring.
